messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Kannada, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Kannada line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (truth‑conditions) | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|------------------------------------------|----------------------|-----------------------|--------| | ove | locative “where” introducing the clause | ಅಲ್ಲಿ | “there / where” | OK | | udirai | future “you will hear” | ಕೇಳುವೆ | “will hear” | OK | | le | definite article, fem. pl (“the”) | — (article omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | disperate | “despairing” (attribute of the shrieks) | ನಿರಾಶಾಜನಕ | “despairing” | OK | | strida | plural “shrieks” (object of hearing) | ಕೂಗನ್ನು | “shrieks” | OK | | vedrai | future “you will see” | ನೋಡುವೆ | “will see” | OK | | li | definite article, masc. pl (“the”) | — (article omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | antichi | “ancient” (attribute of spirits) | ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ | “ancient” | OK | | spiriti | plural “spirits” (object of seeing) | ಆತ್ಮಗಳನ್ನು | “spirits” | OK | | dolenti | “woeful” (predicative of spirits) | ದುಃಖಭರಿತ | “woeful” | OK | | ch’ (che) | relative pronoun “who” referring to spirits | ಅವರು | “they / who” | OK | | a | preposition “to / toward” introducing the object of shouting | — (case marking on ಮರಣವನ್ನು) | — | UNNECESSARY | | la | definite article, fem. sg (“the”) | — (article omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | seconda | ordinal “second” (attribute of death) | ಎರಡನೇ | “second” | OK | | morte | noun “death” (object of shouting) | ಮರಣವನ್ನು | “death” | OK | | ciascun | distributive quantifier “each” | ಪ್ರತಿೊಬ್ಬರು | “each” | OK | | grida | present “cries / shouts” (action of each spirit) | ಘೋಷಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ | “proclaim / shout” | OK |
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `le`, `li`, `a`, `la` – articles and the preposition are naturally omitted in Kannada; their semantic role is encoded by case marking or context. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Kannada script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Kannada text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 115: - Original: ಅಲ್ಲಿ ನೀನು ನಿರಾಶಾಜನಕ ಕೂಗನ್ನು ಕೇಳುವೆ, - Issue: none - Corrected: ಅಲ್ಲಿ ನೀನು ನಿರಾಶಾಜನಕ ಕೂಗನ್ನು ಕೇಳುವೆ, - Line 116: - Original: ನೀನು ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ದುಃಖಭರಿತ ಆತ್ಮಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡುವೆ, - Issue: none - Corrected: ನೀನು ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ದುಃಖಭರಿತ ಆತ್ಮಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡುವೆ, - Line 117: - Original: ಅವರು ಪ್ರತಿೊಬ್ಬರು ಎರಡನೇ ಮರಣವನ್ನು ಘೋಷಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ; - Issue: none - Corrected: ಅವರು ಪ್ರತಿೊಬ್ಬರು ಎರಡನೇ ಮರಣವನ್ನು ಘೋಷಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ;
``` ಅಲ್ಲಿ ನೀನು ನಿರಾಶಾಜನಕ ಕೂಗನ್ನು ಕೇಳುವೆ, ನೀನು ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ದುಃಖಭರಿತ ಆತ್ಮಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡುವೆ, ಅವರು ಪ್ರತಿೊಬ್ಬರು ಎರಡನೇ ಮರಣವನ್ನು ಘೋಷಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ; ```
